tools.name: ice_status
tools.description: Broad fleet attention only, not a named app availability check. For a specific app use ice_query services or health.
tools.documentation: Read-only GET /api/bopbop/status. Covers services, operations, incidents and Shipyard; other domains remain unqueried. Domain observations have independent ages. For a named app, use ice_query with services or health instead.
tools.returns: JSON object with schema_version, ok, report, state, scope, coverage, observation times, limitations and telemetry. Reports also expose summary/items and truncation where applicable. ok=true means the report was processed; it does not establish that a project is healthy.

examples.summary: Fetch fleet attention without a model call.

tools.name: ice_query
tools.description: Get Ice facts: health=project availability + crew + incidents; projects=inventory; services=app probes; shipyard=crew; visits=public page loads; security=probe/auth/ban observations; operations=schedules; traffic=host-wide; usage=tokens; news=briefing.

report.description: Use services for whether an app is up; health for overall project health; shipyard for all crews; projects for inventory.

window.description: Only 24h or 7d; do not silently change an unsupported requested time range.

project.description: Optional exact project name from inventory. OMIT for all projects or fleet-wide questions; never use an empty string or all.

limit.description: Maximum returned rows; use 20 when listing all projects.

tools.documentation: Read-only GET /api/bopbop/query. Server defaults: window=24h; limit=5, or 20 for projects. Omit project for the fleet. visits supports known public apps only; traffic is host-wide and rejects project filters. Snapshot reports do not become history when window=7d. Inspect coverage, item states, source age and limitations before drawing conclusions.
tools.returns: JSON object with schema_version, ok, report, state, scope, coverage, observation times, limitations and telemetry. Reports also expose summary/items and truncation where applicable. ok=true means the report was processed; it does not establish that a project is healthy.

examples.summary: List the inventory; inventory alone does not establish health.
Combined project availability, crew and incident evidence.
Eligible public page loads during the past seven days.

tools.name: ice_detail
tools.description: Get one evidence snapshot using a ref from a prior result. No current observation is refreshed.

ref.description: Opaque ice_ reference copied from an earlier result; expires after ten minutes.

tools.documentation: Read-only GET /api/bopbop/detail. Copy an opaque ice_ reference from a previous result. Snapshots expire after ten minutes and can disappear on restart or another worker. This returns the original evidence; repeat the original query for refreshed observations.
tools.returns: JSON object with schema_version, ok, report, state, scope, coverage, observation times, limitations and telemetry. Reports also expose summary/items and truncation where applicable. ok=true means the report was processed; it does not establish that a project is healthy.

tools.name: ice_explain
tools.description: Explain dashboard concepts, project/crew roles, public usage measurement, security implementations and limitations.

topic.description: Dashboard concept or security topic to explain, such as public usage or fail2ban.

tools.documentation: Read-only GET /api/bopbop/explain. Uses curated dashboard concepts and dated guidance. Security explanations can include selected fail2ban declarations and source modification time; declarations do not prove the running jail or firewall matches them.
tools.returns: JSON object with schema_version, ok, report, state, scope, coverage, observation times, limitations and telemetry. Reports also expose summary/items and truncation where applicable. ok=true means the report was processed; it does not establish that a project is healthy.

examples.summary: Understand public usage measurement and its limits.
Understand security concepts and declared settings.
